correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the ordinary-cut/Alexander-dual definitions for all 12 vertices. A triple is disconnected iff it spans ≤1 graph edge, so K (no disconnected triples) has simplex counts (12,66,80,30). Every one of the 30 distance-2 pairs has exactly two adjacent common neighbors giving one tetrahedron, with two P3 triangles and a free distance-2 edge; 60 valid elementary simplicial collapses leave L=S(original icosahedral sphere) ∪ 6 antipodal edges. Since L⊂K is G-invariant and an ordinary homotopy equivalence, its integral homology is equivariantly isomorphic despite non-equivariant collapse order. Relative chains C1(L,S)=Z[six oriented axes] and H2(S)=Z_epsilon prove integral H1/H2 of K with no torsion. Combinatorial Alexander duality on 12 vertices gives degrees H7 and H8 of the cut, with permutation-sign twist trivial because all 120 automorphisms are even; the dual module is self-dual as signed permutation lattice. Independent fresh Python enumeration from the source adjacency produced 140 disconnected triples, dual counts (12,66,80,30), 60 valid collapses, exactly 120 automorphisms all even and orientation/axis character distribution {(+,6):1,(+,-2):15,(+,0):20,(+,1):24,(-,-6):1,(-,2):15,(-,0):20,(-,-1):24}. This exact finite-graph validation corroborates, but does not replace, the integral simplicial collapse+LES+duality argument. Normalization, characteristic, and degree boundary cases are explicit.

value.rationale: The icosahedral ordinary 3-cut is a natural previously studied non-shellable pure complex with two integral homology degrees and a canonical full A5×C2 action. Determining its exact integral action, not merely Betti ranks or rational characters, is a motivated complete invariant that distinguishes inequivalent integral forms of the same rational representation and gives a reusable geometric cut-dual collapse. The precise structural identification is short and substantially suggested by older independence-complex work, but it is not an arbitrary computation or a textbook restatement of a prior same-object integral theorem. No larger family theorem or equivariant homotopy splitting is claimed.

final_claim: For the ordinary 3-cut complex X of the twelve-vertex icosahedral graph and full automorphism group G=A5×C2, there are integral G-module isomorphisms H~7(X;Z)=Z_epsilon and H~8(X;Z)=U_A, the oriented signed permutation lattice on six antipodal vertex pairs, with other reduced integral homology zero. The rotational rational character (6,-2,0,1,1), rational W6 irreducibility, antipodal minus sign and nonequivariant wedge ranks are already covered by the Oct 11 and Nov 2 prior cut results; the surviving contribution is the cut-specific integral lattice proof using thirty dual tetrahedra collapsed to the invariant original icosahedral sphere plus six antipodal chords. No equivariant homotopy wedge splitting is asserted.
limitations: Already-published same-complex rational symmetry and quotient results are NOT novel; the only surviving contribution is the exact integral ZG-module identification via the new cut-dual collapse.
Independence-complex predecessor has the same integral abstract lattice; novelty is incrementally modest and could be removed by an unindexed equivalence.
